items.name: promo-pill
items.title: Promo pill
items.description: The “New: … →” announcement pill above a hero, filled from a card slot. In the page flow; never interrupts.

items.name: promo-sheet
items.title: Promo offer sheet
items.description: An edge tab that opens an offer sheet from its side (a bottom sheet on phones) with a revealable code and an apply link. Opens only when asked.
items.docs: Requires Base UI 1.8+ (a base-* shadcn project) for the swipeable Drawer.

items.name: promo-progress
items.title: Promo progress
items.description: Progress towards a reward, such as free shipping. Standalone: pass the value, goal and reward.

items.name: promo-sticky-cta
items.title: Promo sticky CTA
items.description: A thumb-zone bar that appears once the element you watch (usually pricing) has scrolled away, and hides when it returns.

items.name: promo-carousel
items.title: Promo carousel
items.description: Every live card in a slot as a swipeable row with a peeking next card, so several campaigns share one place. Never auto-advances.

items.name: promo-inbox
items.title: Promo inbox
items.description: A gift button with a count that lists every live offer on the page, one per campaign, including ones the visitor hid.
items.docs: Requires Base UI 1.8+ (a base-* shadcn project) for the Popover.

items.name: promotion-kits
items.title: Promotion kits
items.description: Ready-made campaigns: storeSaleKit, productLaunchKit and courseEnrolmentKit, each with records in six languages and the provider settings they were designed for.
items.docs: Kits reference sample images under /promo-samples and /sample-pages; pass `images` with your own.

items.name: promo-spotlight
items.title: Promo spotlight
items.description: Points at one feature once: an anchored, non-modal popover with a soft halo on the element. Never takes focus; using the feature counts as a conversion.
items.docs: Requires Base UI 1.8+ for the anchored Popover. Give the promotion `slot` the same value as the component's `name`.

items.name: promo-side-card
items.title: Promo side card
items.description: A “what’s on” card beside the page: docked in the free margin on wide screens, peeking from the edge elsewhere, with a pager when several campaigns run.

items.name: promotion-editor
items.title: Promotion editor
items.description: Create and review a promotion with a live preview of every placement, a preview clock, a plain-language schedule in an explicit time zone and taste warnings. Owns no data.
items.docs: Requires Base UI primitives (a base-* shadcn project): ToggleGroup and Slider use array values. Pass `timeZone` so dates are entered in the campaign's zone, not the reviewer's.

items.name: promo-story
items.title: Promo story
items.description: Full-screen “what’s new” story for dialog records with presentation: story. Pass it to PromoDialog as story={PromoStory}. It only opens when the visitor asks.
items.docs: Requires Base UI 1.8+ (a base-* shadcn project) for the Dialog. Render it through the free dialog: <PromoDialog story={PromoStory} />.

items.name: promotion-account-store
items.title: Account dismissal store
items.description: Dismissals that follow the signed-in visitor across devices, for dismiss.scope: account. Synchronous reads from a local copy, batched saves, and a fetch transport.

items.name: promotions-pro
items.title: Promotions Pro
items.description: Every pro add-on: pill, offer sheet, progress, sticky CTA, carousel, inbox, spotlight, side card, story, kits, editor and the account store.
items.docs: Pro items install from the authenticated @kitsu-pro registry. Add it to components.json with your key in KITSU_PRO_KEY; see the Docs tab on the promotions exhibit.
